channel.title: Versions
channel.description: This is version 3.0. The home page exists in every version, so the version switcher leads to the home page of each.

item.title: Stable
item.description: Exists under this path in every version. The switcher leads to stable in 1.0 and 2.0.

item.title: Moved
item.description: Moved here from moved-a in 1.0 by way of moved-b in 2.0, naming both as an alias, the second one relative. The switcher leads to moved-a in 1.0 and to moved-b in 2.0.

item.title: Guide: Install
item.description: The first half of guide in 1.0 and the one naming it as an alias. The switcher leads to guide in 1.0 and to guide-install in 2.0, where the same path takes precedence over the alias.

item.title: Guide: Usage
item.description: The second half of guide in 1.0, without an alias. The switcher leads to the home page of 1.0 and to guide-usage in 2.0.

item.title: Tabs
item.description: Took in tab of 1.0 and 2.0, naming it as an alias. The switcher leads to tabs in 1.0 and 2.0, as the same path takes precedence over the alias.

item.title: Added
item.description: Exists in this version only. The switcher leads to the home page of 1.0 and 2.0.

item.title: Gap
item.description: Exists in 1.0 and 3.0 but not in 2.0. The switcher leads to gap in 1.0 and to the home page of 2.0.

item.title: Renamed
item.description: Renamed from renamed-old in 1.0, naming it as an alias. The switcher leads to renamed-old in 1.0 and to renamed-new in 2.0.
